title: motion-samples/1 — one clip's world joint positions per frame
description: Written as JSON by humanoid-motion twocam/solve.py (--samples-out) and as NPZ by humanoid-motion contact_bake.py (--samples-out: `positions` (frames, joints, 3), `names`, `fps`, optional `contacts` (frames, 2: l, r), `reading_joints` with `reading_names`, and `meta`, a JSON string holding the optional keys below; a reader stamps it motion-samples/1 and rebuilds `joints` from `positions` and `names`); read by blender-retarget motion_metrics.py (and clip_metrics.py's plant helpers) and by contact_bake.py (--rig-info for `sole_offsets`, --readings for `reading_joints`). Metres, Z up unless `up` says y. Every joint has the same number of frames (motion_metrics refuses fewer than 4, and refuses a named joint that is missing; not expressible here). Producers add their own keys freely.

up.description: default z; y turns a Y-up file with (x, y, z) -> (x, -z, y)

joints.description: joint name -> one [x, y, z] per frame

root.description: default: the first of Root, Hips, hips, pelvis, Pelvis present

feet.description: each foot's joints (foot, then toe); required by motion_metrics unless --feet names them

segments.description: parent -> child joint pairs, for pops

parents.description: child -> parent joint, read as more segments

limits.description: the bend at a chain's middle joint (0 = straight) must stay in [min_deg, max_deg]

travel_mps.description: an in-place loop's travel speed [vx, vy]

source.description: the retarget's source root and the scale it was given (translation check)

two_view.description: the two-camera route's block (solve.py); extra keys such as reprojection_basis and limb_reprojection_px are reports

sole_offsets.description: a foot joint's rest height over its sole, metres

reading_joints.description: frames x reading_names x 3: the joints read straight from the source, for pops_in_source
